topic.title: Drive mode: hands-free voice
topic.shortdesc: A full-screen voice mode for the car: hear what's new, go through approvals and ask for things, with one big button or none at all.

image.alt: Drive mode on a phone: the mode switch, who you are talking to, and one large Talk button.

body.p: Open it from Drive mode in Chat. The screen stays awake, and after the first tap a headset or steering-wheel play/pause button works as the big button. Exit goes back to Chat.

dlentry.dd: It listens again after each answer; speak, then pause.

body.p: While it speaks, the button says Interrupt. Talking to chooses a role; the default, Chief of Staff (hands it on), works out who should do it.
Under the fold-out you can type a command, turn on Listen for a follow-up after each answer, and use the server's voice instead of the phone's.
body.note: Approvals by voice always ask you to confirm: say approve, hear what it is, then say yes, approve. A request such as approve the quote for Jane is sent to the agent as a request, never taken as an approval.

body.p: A command must be the whole thing you say. OK, hey, please and thanks around it are fine. Anything else is sent to the agent as a request.

strow.stentry: what's new, brief me, catch me up
Go through what needs your approval, one at a time.
Start approving or rejecting the one just read. It reads it back and asks you to confirm.
talk to the shop lead, back to chief of staff
Choose who you are talking to.

body.p: To send one request to a business or role, start with its name: shop: has order 1042 shipped? or ask customer support whether order 1042 shipped. Spoken names work: d m s or machine shop, three d p and me, open v, open d, personal.
When the agent asks you a question, whatever you say next is your answer; only stop, cancel, end, repeat and the mode switches still work as commands.

The talk button shows a live trace of your voice while you speak and of the reply while it is spoken, beside the orb. Under Show in the settings you can keep both, or choose the orb only or the trace only.
